scope: standalone Cell CPU; real process wall and inference timing; not native egglog
path_policy: equal-length executable/input links and numeric output names
process_wait: blocking waitpid with a separate timeout watchdog; no polling sleeps

timing_accounting.process_unattributed_seconds: wall minus load, setup, inference and export; includes report construction, output, teardown and other unmeasured intervals
timing_accounting.report_seconds: reported runtime.report and report additions before export; absent for old binaries, never imputed as zero
timing_accounting.process_after_report_residual_seconds: process_unattributed_seconds minus measured report_seconds; only available when report is measured; includes serialization/output, teardown and other unmeasured intervals
timing_accounting.interpretation: Residuals are differences of measured intervals, not isolated measurements of serialization or drop; medians of separate phases need not sum to median wall
